summary: Arcane Power build that keeps 4 Arcane Blast stacks up, for 48% of Intellect as spell damage, and casts Arcane Wrath on cooldown with Accelerant. Frostbolt is the filler, with extra Arcane Blasts while there is mana to spare. It wears the Arcane gear with Gloves - Arcane Power.
rotation: Pre-pull: Arcane Blast at -1.5s so it lands at the pull
Presence of Mind for an instant Arcane Wrath whenever both are ready
Arcane Power and Presence of Mind with the on-use trinket, unless the trinket won't be back in time. Other cooldowns on a free GCD. No mana gems.
Fire Blast when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 0.75s). No Arcane Explosion: it reaches 10 yd and Arcane stands at Fire Blast's 20
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc, ahead of the Arcane Blasts
Arcane Blast to 4 stacks. Each stack gives 12% of Intellect as spell damage, for 18s from the first.
Arcane Wrath on cooldown (3s cast with Accelerant)
Arcane Blast ahead of the filler while the mana is more than 75 a second of the fight left: mana the fight couldn't otherwise spend
Wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Precision (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Open: when Arcane Blast stacks apply, and whether new stacks reset the 18s.
Assumed: Arcane Missiles ticks can proc Arcane Concentration, at most once a second.
Assumed: how Arcane Mind adds crit.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Fireball stops at rank XI, Frostbolt at X and Arcane Missiles at VII. The books would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_arcane unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Precision) as a mage option, as the preset does. Gnome since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Distance 20 yd since 2026-11-02 (standards 33, orchestration/caster_distance.md: Fire Blast, which its finisher casts; the finisher dropped Arcane Explosion, 10 yd), 25 before.
